title: Fuglede's Conjecture on Cyclic Groups of Square-Free Order: The Case of Rapidly Growing Prime Factors
summary: The main result of the paper is that an inductive argument is established to prove the Fuglede's conjecture for an infinite sequence of square-free order cyclic groups. The tile-to-spectral direction of the conjecture holds for all square-free cyclic groups, whereas we prove the spectral-tiling direction only for those groups among them whose prime factors grow rapidly. To achieve this, we develop an inductive technique with roots in a previous paper by the author co-authored with Fallon, Kiss, and Mayeli.
